entries.2fd9a190baf6707d: As priority issues to address, it lists three points: expanding its customer base by strengthening its core business, improving operational efficiency through the construction of a new information system, and developing and securing human resources. It recognizes as an issue the need to further increase the number of sales customers, and states that it will strengthen community-based sales activities at each sales base to expand its customer base in regions where its share is low. It also states that it will proceed with a fundamental rebuilding of its core systems and with securing a diverse workforce through year-round recruitment.

entries.84cc741b8b040286: Under the aim to expand one-stop functions, it states that it will strengthen its extensive product inventory lineup and inventory sales, maximizing the value-added advantages of on-hand stock and same-day delivery. On the processing side, it states that its services go beyond in-house processing from raw material to primary processing (cutting, drilling, etc.) and secondary processing (welded structures), and that it also works with a variety of processing partner companies to handle everything from small to large orders and high-level processing. On the logistics side, it sets out the use of scheduled services by partner carriers and stronger coordination between warehouse handling and transport operations.

The information on major customers states that there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. The MD&A explains that construction demand fell as construction work was delayed by labor shortages, leading domestic steel demand to remain weak; that steel prices moved softly under the influence of Chinese steel exports; and that competition intensified in the steel distribution industry as well.
